SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(rc.camp_id AS CHAR) AS campId, CAST(rc.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName, CAST(rc.group_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryGroupId, g.group_name AS roomCategoryGroupName, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(rc.display_name, rc.name) AS name, COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0) AS roomNum, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.room_name ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM room r WHERE r.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) AS roomNames, COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0) AS inventory, rc.guest_count AS checkinGuestCount, rc.weekday_price_cent AS basePrice, rc.weekend_price_cent AS weekendPrice, rc.holiday_price_cent AS holidayPrice, rc.location_mode AS locationMode, rc.location_province_code AS locationProvinceCode, rc.location_province_name AS locationProvinceName, rc.location_city_code AS locationCityCode, rc.location_city_name AS locationCityName, rc.location_district_code AS locationDistrictCode, rc.location_district_name AS locationDistrictName, rc.street_address AS streetAddress, rc.community_name AS communityName, rc.building_unit AS buildingUnit, rc.door_number AS doorNumber, rc.location_latitude AS locationLatitude, rc.location_longitude AS locationLongitude, rc.rental_type AS rentalType, rc.property_type AS propertyType, rc.suite_area AS suiteArea, rc.bedroom_count AS bedroomCount, rc.living_room_count AS livingRoomCount, rc.kitchen_count AS kitchenCount, rc.bathroom_count AS bathroomCount, rc.bathroom_type AS bathroomType, rc.earliest_check_in_hour AS earliestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_in_hour AS latestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_out_hour AS latestCheckOutTime, rc.display_name AS displayName, rc.selected_facility_ids AS selectedFacilityIds, rc.bed_sheet_change_policy AS bedSheetChangePolicy, rc.decoration_style AS decorationStyle, rc.highlight_description AS highlightDescription, rc.nearby_description AS nearbyDescription, rc.article_description AS articleDescription, ( SELECT CAST(m.media_resource_id AS CHAR) FROM room_category_media m WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhotoMediaId, ( SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM room_category_media m LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhotoMediaUrl, ( SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM room_category_media m LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhoto, p.address AS fullAddress FROM room_category rc LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = rc.poi_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 LEFT JOIN room_category_group g ON g.group_id = rc.group_id AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1
ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT rc.name AS roomName, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND r.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ), COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0)) AS inventory, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND om.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status = 'checked_in' ) AS staying, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND om.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status IN ('booked', 'pending', 'refunding') ) AS pendingOrders FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ca.channel_name, ''), CONCAT('渠道', ca.channel_id)) AS label, rc.weekday_price_cent AS basePrice, rc.weekend_price_cent AS weekendPrice, rel.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, rel.audit_status AS auditStatus FROM channel_room_category_rel rel JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = rel.account_id AND ca.camp_id = rel.camp_id JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = rel.camp_id WHERE rel.camp_id = #{campId} AND rel.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} ORDER BY ca.account_id ASC

SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(rc.camp_id AS CHAR) AS campId, CAST(rc.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName, CAST(rc.group_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryGroupId, g.group_name AS roomCategoryGroupName, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(rc.display_name, rc.name) AS name, COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0) AS roomNum, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.room_name ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM room r WHERE r.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) AS roomNames, rc.weekday_price_cent AS basePrice, rc.weekend_price_cent AS weekendPrice, rc.holiday_price_cent AS holidayPrice, rc.location_mode AS locationMode, rc.location_province_code AS locationProvinceCode, rc.location_province_name AS locationProvinceName, rc.location_city_code AS locationCityCode, rc.location_city_name AS locationCityName, rc.location_district_code AS locationDistrictCode, rc.location_district_name AS locationDistrictName, rc.street_address AS streetAddress, rc.community_name AS communityName, rc.building_unit AS buildingUnit, rc.door_number AS doorNumber, rc.location_latitude AS locationLatitude, rc.location_longitude AS locationLongitude, rc.rental_type AS rentalType, rc.property_type AS propertyType, rc.suite_area AS suiteArea, rc.bedroom_count AS bedroomCount, rc.living_room_count AS livingRoomCount, rc.kitchen_count AS kitchenCount, rc.bathroom_count AS bathroomCount, rc.bathroom_type AS bathroomType, rc.earliest_check_in_hour AS earliestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_in_hour AS latestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_out_hour AS latestCheckOutTime, rc.display_name AS displayName, rc.selected_facility_ids AS selectedFacilityIds, rc.bed_sheet_change_policy AS bedSheetChangePolicy, rc.decoration_style AS decorationStyle, rc.highlight_description AS highlightDescription, rc.nearby_description AS nearbyDescription, rc.article_description AS articleDescription, rc.guest_count AS checkinGuestCount FROM room_category rc LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = rc.poi_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 LEFT JOIN room_category_group g ON g.group_id = rc.group_id AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1 WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS id, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(rc.display_name, rc.name) AS name FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id != #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC

SELECT CAST(m.media_resource_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(m.media_resource_id AS CHAR) AS mediaResourceId, CAST(m.media_id AS CHAR) AS mediaId, m.scene_type AS sectionKey, COALESCE(mr.name, CONCAT('照片', m.sort_no)) AS name, COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) AS url, COALESCE(mr.size_bytes, 0) AS size, CASE WHEN mr.format = 'jpg' OR mr.format = 'jpeg' THEN 'image/jpeg' WHEN mr.format = 'png' THEN 'image/png' WHEN mr.format IS NOT NULL AND mr.format != '' THEN CONCAT('image/', mr.format) ELSE 'image/*' END AS mimeType, m.sort_no AS sortOrder FROM room_category_media m LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.camp_id = #{campId} AND m.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND m.media_type = 'image' AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.scene_type ASC, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC
SELECT media_resource_id FROM media_resource WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND url = #{url} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY media_resource_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_category_linkage ( id, camp_id, room_category_id, linked_room_category_id, relation_type, status ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{campId}, #{roomCategoryId}, #{linkedRoomCategoryId}, 'close_linkage', 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO room_category_media ( media_id, camp_id, room_category_id, media_resource_id, media_type, media_url, scene_type, sort_no, status ) VALUES ( #{mediaId}, #{campId}, #{roomCategoryId}, #{mediaResourceId}, 'image', #{mediaUrl}, #{sceneType}, #{sortNo}, 1 )

INSERT INTO room_category ( room_category_id, camp_id, poi_id, group_id, name, display_name, room_count, rental_type, property_type, guest_count, suite_area, bedroom_count, living_room_count, kitchen_count, bathroom_count, bathroom_type, weekday_price_cent, weekend_price_cent, holiday_price_cent, location_mode, location_province_code, location_province_name, location_city_code, location_city_name, location_district_code, location_district_name, street_address, community_name, building_unit, door_number, location_latitude, location_longitude, earliest_check_in_hour, latest_check_in_hour, latest_check_out_hour, selected_facility_ids, bed_sheet_change_policy, decoration_style, highlight_description, nearby_description, article_description, status, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{roomCategoryId}, #{campId}, #{poiId}, #{groupId}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{roomCount}, #{rentalType}, #{propertyType}, #{guestCount}, #{suiteArea}, #{bedroomCount}, #{livingRoomCount}, #{kitchenCount}, #{bathroomCount}, #{bathroomType}, #{weekdayPriceCent}, #{weekendPriceCent}, #{holidayPriceCent}, #{locationMode}, #{locationProvinceCode}, #{locationProvinceName}, #{locationCityCode}, #{locationCityName}, #{locationDistrictCode}, #{locationDistrictName}, #{streetAddress}, #{communityName}, #{buildingUnit}, #{doorNumber}, #{locationLatitude}, #{locationLongitude}, #{earliestCheckInHour}, #{latestCheckInHour}, #{latestCheckOutHour}, #{selectedFacilityIds}, #{bedSheetChangePolicy}, #{decorationStyle}, #{highlightDescription}, #{nearbyDescription}, #{articleDescription}, 1, 0, #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE room_category SET poi_id = #{poiId}, group_id = #{groupId}, name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName}, room_count = #{roomCount}, rental_type = #{rentalType}, property_type = #{propertyType}, guest_count = #{guestCount}, suite_area = #{suiteArea}, bedroom_count = #{bedroomCount}, living_room_count = #{livingRoomCount}, kitchen_count = #{kitchenCount}, bathroom_count = #{bathroomCount}, bathroom_type = #{bathroomType}, weekday_price_cent = #{weekdayPriceCent}, weekend_price_cent = #{weekendPriceCent}, holiday_price_cent = #{holidayPriceCent}, location_mode = #{locationMode}, location_province_code = #{locationProvinceCode}, location_province_name = #{locationProvinceName}, location_city_code = #{locationCityCode}, location_city_name = #{locationCityName}, location_district_code = #{locationDistrictCode}, location_district_name = #{locationDistrictName}, street_address = #{streetAddress}, community_name = #{communityName}, building_unit = #{buildingUnit}, door_number = #{doorNumber}, location_latitude = #{locationLatitude}, location_longitude = #{locationLongitude}, earliest_check_in_hour = #{earliestCheckInHour}, latest_check_in_hour = #{latestCheckInHour}, latest_check_out_hour = #{latestCheckOutHour}, selected_facility_ids = #{selectedFacilityIds}, bed_sheet_change_policy = #{bedSheetChangePolicy}, decoration_style = #{decorationStyle}, highlight_description = #{highlightDescription}, nearby_description = #{nearbyDescription}, article_description = #{articleDescription}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE room SET status = 0, is_deleted = 1, room_name = CONCAT('deleted-', room_id), room_no = CONCAT('deleted-', room_id), updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND is_deleted = 0
